name: Red-Eyes Alternative Ultimate Dragon
text:
"Red-Eyes Black Dragon" + "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" + "Red-Eyes Black Dragon"
 This card cannot be destroyed by card effect. Once Per Turn: You can discard 1 card then destroy 1 card your opponent controls. If this card was Fusion Summoned using a monster whos original name is "Red-Eyes Alternative Dragon" as material. you can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls instead. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.
